claims.statement: For odd N≥3, nonzero a, and holes H, S=Z_N\H decomposes uniquely as B disjoint-union (B+a) iff each +a cycle has holes and all cyclic hole gaps are odd.
Any genuine mark of a t=5 modular distinct-subset-sum set passes the inverse-hole criterion; its unique B contains zero and equals the subset sums of the other marks.
